title: Night Crickets Back Porch.aiff
description: Recording of summer night sounds from my back porch, facing the woods. Recorded with an H2Zoom and edited (trimmed only) with Audacity. Sample taken from Charlotte, North Carolina USA.

title: Crickets At Night - Raw sound
description:
Crickets recorded at night, in my garden, in summer, with a stormy weather in background.  

 Recorded with a Tascam DR-05. No post-process.  If you want the post-processed sound with the background noise removed, find "Crickets At Night - Clean sound".  

 I recorded this sound intended to use it in the video game I'm currently developing : The Elven Decline.

title: Wind singing in the mountain, some night cricket in background
description:
Wind blowing and howling on the top of the sacred mountain (for the Huichole people) close to Real de Catorce (Mexico, San Luis Potosi). Some night cricket in background. Recorded at night in the Wirikuta Desert. 

 Sound recorded by a MS setup Schoeps Microphone CCM41+CCM8 Sound Devices 744T MS is encoded in STEREO Left-Right recorded in july 2012 

 more sounds on  http://www.felixblume.com  

 Please rate the sound or comment it if you like it !

title: crickets_creek.wav

title: FrogsAndCrickets_ExcerptB_JMA_24Bit_48k.wav
